adjudication.rationale: In `EmbedController`, `before_filter :ensure_embeddable` runs before `best`, and `ensure_embeddable` raises `Discourse::InvalidAccess` when `SiteSetting.embeddable_host.blank?` (default is `''` per `config/site_settings.yml`). The spec `it "is 404 without an embed_url"` does not stub `embeddable_host` or `request.referer`, so the request will fail in the before_filter before `params.require(:embed_url)` is evaluated. Thus the test passes (`response.should_not be_success`) for the wrong reason and does not actually exercise/assert the “missing embed_url” behavior or a 404 status.
